groups.query: serious doubts about modern darwinian theory cambrian explosion sudden appearance new animals evidence

claims.text: So, two serious doubts about modern Darwinian theory: The Cambrian Explosion—the sudden appearance of new animals, which evolutionary theory has failed to explain; and the DNA enigma—the implausibility of random mutations producing the information needed to build new forms of animal life.

groups.query: novel animal forms exhibiting proto types body designs see today emerged fossil evidence

claims.text: These novel animal forms—exhibiting proto-types of most animal body designs we see today—emerged in the fossil record without evidence of earlier ancestors.

groups.query: show book darwin’s doubt even billion years life’s history enough time overcome evidence

claims.text: As I show in my book Darwin’s Doubt, even 4 billion years of life’s history is not enough time to overcome a search problem this big.
